dialog.english: So, where do we go from here?

Gennai told us to go to Server
Continent, but...
dialog.translation:
Gennai nos dijo que fuéramos
al Continente Server, pero...

dialog.english:
According to the map I just
received, Server Continent is
quite a distance from here.
dialog.translation:
Según el mapa que recibí,
el Continente Server está
bastante lejos de aquí.

dialog.english:
Do we *have* to go? I mean,
Devimon's gone...
dialog.translation:
¿Tenemos que ir? O sea,
Devimon ya no está...

dialog.english:
We know this island pretty well,
and we won't have problems finding
food and water.
dialog.translation:
Conocemos bien esta isla,
y no tendremos problemas
para encontrar comida y agua.

dialog.english: What do you mean by that?

I mean, can we trust this Gennai
guy and what he said about Server
Continent?
dialog.translation:
O sea, ¿podemos fiarnos de
ese tal Gennai y lo que dijo
del Continente Server?

dialog.english:
Can we believe he's on our side
just because he sent us a map?
dialog.translation:
¿Podemos fiarnos de él solo
porque envió un mapa?

dialog.english:
But if we just hang around here,
we'll never return home!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero si nos quedamos aquí,
nunca volveremos a casa!

dialog.english:
We had so much trouble with
Devimon, and there are even more
dangerous enemies ahead...
dialog.translation:
Ya tuvimos bastante con
Devimon, y hay enemigos aún
más peligrosos por delante...

dialog.english:
We don't even have a way to get to
a continent across the ocean.
dialog.translation:
Ni siquiera tenemos cómo cruzar
el océano hasta el continente.

dialog.english:
And there are probably even more
weird Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Y seguro que hay Digimon
aún más raros.

dialog.english:
We should probably check this
place out a bit more.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos investigar un
poco más este lugar.

dialog.english: What's with you guys?
...Let's go.
T.K?!

Even if we don't know what kind of
enemies will be waiting for us, we
should go!
dialog.translation:
¡Aunque no sepamos qué
enemigos nos esperan, deberíamos
ir de todos modos!

dialog.english:
I think Angemon would agree, so,
I...
dialog.translation:
Angemon diría que sí,
así que, yo...

dialog.english:
We'll go! At the very least, if we
can find those Tags and Crests...
dialog.translation:
¡Vamos! Al menos así
podremos encontrar los
Circuitos y Emblemas...

dialog.english:
I'm sure I can evolve more and
protect you, Tai!
dialog.translation:
¡Seguro que puedo evolucionar
más y protegerte, Tai!

dialog.english: Agumon...
Let's go, Sora!
We'll pull through, okay?

I'll be the most beautiful flower
on Server Continent!
dialog.translation:
¡Seré la flor más bonita del
Continente Server!

dialog.english:
I'll cross the whole ocean if I
have to!
dialog.translation:
¡Cruzaré el océano entero
si hace falta!

dialog.english: Matt, let's go!
...okay!
Let's go!
Okay, I'll go too!

If everyone else is going, I'll
tag along!
dialog.translation:
¡Si todos vais a ir, yo
también me apunto!

dialog.english: A new continent, huh?

Okay, it's decided! We're going to
Server Continent!
Yeah!

Now that it looks like you're done
talking...
dialog.translation:
Ahora que parece que
acabasteis de hablar...

dialog.english: Leomon!

We heard rumors that you're going
to Server Continent, and these
guys wanted to help you out.
dialog.translation:
Oímos que ibais al
Continente Server, y estos
querían echaros una mano.

dialog.english: Hey!

You need a ship, right? We'll help
out!
We want to help you guys, too.
Thanks, guys!
How do we get to the other side?

You can cross if you can find
something to use as a bridge.
dialog.translation:
Podéis cruzar si encontráis
algo que sirva de puente.

dialog.english: To use as a bridge...?

Yes, like a bunch of logs or
something.
dialog.translation:
Sí, como troncos o
algo así.

dialog.english: Logs...okay, let's go find some!

Be careful around here. The trees
are falling in this direction.
dialog.translation:
Cuidado por aquí. Los árboles
caen hacia este lado.

dialog.english:
Are you cutting down trees to make
a raft?

These are some nice logs! Hey,
Leomon! Can we use them?
Take as many as you like!

Hey, Centarumon, we found some
logs!

Ah, perfect. They'll make a good
bridge.
dialog.translation:
Ah, perfecto. Harán un buen
puente.

dialog.english: There, now you can cross.
Thanks, Centarumon!
What are you doing, Elecmon?

Oh, I'm trying to fish for food,
but I don't have any bait.
dialog.translation:
Intento pescar comida, pero
no tengo cebo.

dialog.english:
In that case, we'll help you out
and find some bait!
dialog.translation:
¡En ese caso, te ayudamos
a buscar cebo!

dialog.english: Thanks!
Heeeey, Mojyamon!
I've found some nice food!
Really? What'd you find?
Look, some nice earthworms!

Kyaaaaaah! They're squirming
around...

Mojyamon, humans can't eat
earthworms.
dialog.translation:
Mojyamon, los humanos no
comen lombrices.

dialog.english: You should've told me sooner!

But we can use it for fish bait!
If that's okay with you.
dialog.translation:
¡Pero sirve de cebo para
pescar! Si no te importa.

dialog.english: Yeah! Take it!
Thanks! This'll be a great help!
Elecmon! We got some bait!

The fish'll be biting like crazy
with this. One sec...see, look!
dialog.translation:
Con esto picarán un montón.
¡Un momento...mirad, mirad!

dialog.english: Ah! A DigiCarp!
Heheh, I'm not bad at this!
dialog.translation: ¡Jeje, no se me da mal esto!

dialog.english: Thank you!
It's mine!
I'm the one who found it!

Meramon...and Frigimon? Why are
you two fighting?
dialog.translation:
Meramon...¿y Frigimon? ¿Por
qué peleáis vosotros dos?

dialog.english:
It's this DigiPiece! Meramon
called dibs on it, but I'm the one
who found it!
dialog.translation:
¡Es esta DigiPieza! ¡Meramon
dijo que era suya, pero yo
la encontré!

dialog.english:
I was the one who climbed the tree
to retrieve it from the branch!
All *you* did was find it!
dialog.translation:
¡Yo fui el que subió al árbol
para bajarla de la rama! ¡Tú
solo la encontraste!

dialog.english:
But all you did was climb a tree.
Honestly, you fire-type Digimon
are so pushy...
dialog.translation:
Pero solo subiste a un árbol.
Los Digimon de fuego sois
muy pesados...

dialog.english:
No, Ice-type Digimon are just
cowards! Give me back my
DigiPiece!
dialog.translation:
¡No, los de hielo sois
cobardes! ¡Devuélveme mi
DigiPieza!

dialog.english:
Stop it! I asked you to explain,
not to start fighting again!
dialog.translation:
¡Basta! ¡Os pedí que
explicarais, no que os
peleaseis de nuevo!

dialog.english:
Okay, then you decide whose
DigiPiece it is, Tai!
dialog.translation:
¡Vale, entonces decide tú de
quién es, Tai!

dialog.english: Hey, that's a good idea!

Huh? Don't just spring that on me
all of a sudden.
dialog.translation:
¿Eh? No me pongas eso
así de repente.

dialog.english: Frigimon found it, so it's his!
Meramon did the work, so it's his!
See? It's mine!

If that's what Tai says, I have
to go along with it.
dialog.translation:
Si Tai lo dice, tendré
que aceptarlo.

dialog.english:
Hey, don't feel bad! So, about the
DigiPiece I found...
dialog.translation:
¡No te pongas triste! Sobre
la DigiPieza que encontré...

dialog.english: Here, Tai! You can have it!
Huh? Me?

Yeah! When I found it, I was
thinking I'd give you it as a
present.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Cuando la encontré,
pensé en dártela como
regalo!

dialog.english:
Hey, that's what I was planning,
too!
dialog.translation:
¡Eso es justo lo que yo
pensaba hacer!

dialog.english:
Well, now that we've cleared that
up... thanks!
So, here's the...huh?
What's wrong?

The DigiPiece changed. Maybe it's
because I was holding it?
dialog.translation:
La DigiPieza cambió. ¿Quizás
por tenerla yo en la mano?

dialog.english: Huh, so that can happen?

See, I knew you'd say that,
Tai!
Hmmm, I'm not convinced...

Hahaha, the people who put in
effort are the ones who get
rewarded. Don't feel too bad!
dialog.translation:
Jaja, el que se esfuerza
recibe su recompensa.
¡No te pongas triste!

dialog.english: Here, Tai, it's for you!
Ehh? For me?

I was thinking I'd give it to you,
so here, take it!

Huh, that's what I was thinking as
well.
dialog.translation:
Vaya, eso es justo lo que
yo pensaba.

dialog.english:
Well, now that we've cleared that
up... thanks!
So, here's the...huh?
What's wrong?

The DigiPiece changed. Maybe it's
because I was holding it?
dialog.translation:
La DigiPieza cambió. ¿Quizás
por tenerla yo en la mano?

dialog.english: Huh, so that can happen?
Tai!
Hm? What's up, Yokomon?

A present for you, Tai! I found
this in the forest, so I thought
I'd give it to you!
dialog.translation:
¡Un regalo para ti, Tai!
¡Lo encontré en el bosque,
y quise dártelo!

dialog.english: Thanks, Yokomon!
You're welcome!
Hm? I smell fish...

Oh! Elecmon gave this to us. See,
it's a DigiCarp! Are you hungry?
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! Nos dio esto Elecmon.
¡Mira, una DigiCarpa! ¿Tienes
hambre?

dialog.english:
No, thank you...I don't really
like fish.
dialog.translation:
No, gracias...no me gusta
el pescado.

dialog.english: Huh, that's a surprise.

That's not good! Mommy always told
me that you can't get strong if
you don't eat fish!
dialog.translation:
¡Eso no está bien! ¡Mi mamá
siempre dijo que hay que
comer pescado para ser fuerte!

dialog.english:
Well...you're probably right,
but...

You say something to Leomon too,
Tai!
Leomon, you shouldn't be picky.
You should listen to Leomon.

No, it's not that. I got food
poisoning from a fish once and 
seeing one makes my whiskers itch.
dialog.translation:
No, no es eso. Una vez
me intoxiqué con pescado y
ver uno me da repelús.

dialog.english: Oh! So you're not being picky?
Sorry, Leomon!
Sorry about that, Leomon.

Don't worry about it! It's just
that my whiskers get on edge even
at the mention of fish.
dialog.translation:
¡No pasa nada! Es solo que
me da repelús solo con
mencionar el pescado.

dialog.english: Okay, but why?

Actually, I got food poisoning
from a fish a while back and even
seeing one makes my whiskers itch.
dialog.translation:
La verdad, me intoxiqué con
pescado hace tiempo y hasta
verlo me da repelús.

dialog.english: Ah, so that's it...

Can't do anything about that.
Sorry, I shouldn't have tried to
get you to eat it.
dialog.translation:
No se puede hacer nada.
Perdón, no debí intentar
que lo comieras.

dialog.english: No big deal, don't worry about it.
dialog.translation: No pasa nada, no te preocupes.

dialog.english: We've got logs to make a raft...

And some fish to eat while we're
on the ocean, but...
dialog.translation:
Y pescado para comer en
el océano, pero...

dialog.english:
We can't find a large cloth to
make a sail...
dialog.translation:
No encontramos tela para
hacer una vela...

dialog.english: That's no good.

Let's head back to where we
started, then. We'll come up with
a new plan.
dialog.translation:
Volvamos a donde empezamos,
entonces. Pensaremos un
nuevo plan.

dialog.english:
Yeah. There aren't any dangerous
Digimon around here, anyway.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Además, no hay Digimon
peligrosos por aquí.

dialog.english: Hey, everyone!
Monzaemon! What's up?

I thought you'd need a cloth to
make a sail, so I picked one up at
Toy Town!
dialog.translation:
¡Pensé que necesitaríais
tela para una vela, y cogí
una en el País de los Juguetes!

dialog.english: Really?!

Yeah! Though to be honest, it's
actually my bedsheet...
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Aunque, la verdad,
es mi propia sábana...

dialog.english:
As long as it's big enough for a
sail, it's fine!
dialog.translation:
¡Con que sea lo bastante
grande, nos vale!

dialog.english: Really? I'm glad!
We can finish the raft now!
I'll carry the raft for you.
Are you ready to leave?
Yeah! Let's go to Server Continent!
We're not ready yet. Wait a little!

All right, we'll wait for you at
the beach!
Call us when you're ready.

I wonder if this'll hold up out
there...
dialog.translation:
Espero que esto aguante
allí fuera...

dialog.english:
I'm sure if anyone can get across
this ocean, it'll be you guys.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que si alguien puede
cruzar este océano, sois
vosotros.

dialog.english:
Thanks, Leomon! It's all thanks to
all your help.
dialog.translation:
¡Gracias, Leomon! Todo
gracias a tu ayuda.

dialog.english: Ah!
What's wrong?!
The DigiEgg, it hatched!
How cute!
Yaaaaay!
Thank you so much!
Goodbye!
Farewell, Chosen Children!
Ugh, I don't feel good...

I didn't think it would shake this
much.
dialog.translation:
No pensé que se movería
tanto.

dialog.english:
How much longer are we gonna be on
here?
We've just started!

But we only have so much food and
water. There's only enough for
about half a month.
dialog.translation:
Pero tenemos comida y agua
limitadas. Solo alcanza para
medio mes más o menos.

dialog.english: Joe...
You've gotta pull yourself together!
If we run out, we can catch fish.

I'm just worried because I'm your
senior! If we run out of food,
we're done for!
dialog.translation:
¡Me preocupo porque soy el
mayor! ¡Si se acaba la comida,
estamos perdidos!

dialog.english: Well, you're right, but...

You're right! And there'll
probably be rain before we run out
of water!
dialog.translation:
¡Tienes razón! ¡Y seguro que
lloverá antes de que se
acabe el agua!

dialog.english:
Yeah! If we put our minds to it,
things will work out somehow.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Si nos lo proponemos,
las cosas saldrán bien.

dialog.english:
Thanks, Tai! I feel a bit
better now!
dialog.translation:
¡Gracias, Tai! ¡Ya me siento
un poco mejor!

dialog.english: W-what's going on?
Kyaaaaaaaaaah!

Something's approaching us from
behind!
An island!
No, that's not an island!

It's Whamon! He usually stays at
the bottom of the ocean, so why is
he here?
dialog.translation:
¡Es Whamon! Suele estar en
el fondo del océano, ¿por
qué está aquí?

dialog.english: He's coming this way!
We're gonna get swallowed!

We're being consumed! And by
"consumed", I don't mean the
economic definition!
dialog.translation:
¡Nos está devorando! ¡Y no
me refiero al sentido
económico de la palabra!

dialog.english: We *know*!
So he really is eating us...

And we can't do anything but sit
and watch.
dialog.translation:
Y no podemos hacer nada
más que mirar.

dialog.english: We're in an open space...

I think we're out of the
esophagus. In other words, we're
in the stomach.
dialog.translation:
Creo que salimos del
esófago. O sea que estamos
en el estómago.

dialog.english: Isn't that where food is digested?
dialog.translation: ¿No es donde se digiere la comida?

dialog.english:
If we don't escape from here
quickly, *we're* the ones who'll
be digested!
dialog.translation:
¡Si no escapamos rápido de
aquí, los digeridos vamos
a ser nosotros!

dialog.english: Ah! Tai, over there!
A black gear...

So that's why Whamon's on a
rampage!
dialog.translation:
¡Así que por eso Whamon
está loco!

dialog.english:
I'll give you something to climb
on! Poison Ivy!
Okay, I'm going!

There's a pool of gastric juice
underneath, this thing's swaying a
lot ...ah!
dialog.translation:
¡Hay un charco de jugo
gástrico debajo, esto se
mueve mucho...ah!

dialog.english: Tai!
Tai! Step on the left ivy!
Tai! Step on the right ivy!
Ah!...There we go!

Okay! Now grab it with your right
hand!

Thanks, Matt! You're a huge
help!

You're not too bad yourself, with
that quick reaction and all.
dialog.translation:
Tú tampoco estás mal, con
esa reacción tan rápida.

dialog.english:
Well, I'll leave it to you to
guide me up there!
dialog.translation:
¡Bueno, te dejo que me
guíes hasta arriba!

dialog.english: Oof! There we go! Ah?!

The other way! On *my* right, not
your right!
dialog.translation:
¡Al otro lado! ¡A mi
derecha, no la tuya!

dialog.english: I can't think that quickly!

Hey! I'm trying to help you out
here!
Just keep your mouth shut, okay...
dialog.translation: Cierra la boca y calla, vale...

dialog.english: Just a bit more! Keep at it!

All right, I'm pulling out the
gear!
Uwaaaaaaaah!
Are you okay, Sora?
Yeah!
We made it out, somehow!
Are you okay, Poyomon?

I apologize for acting so
violently.

No worries! It's the black gear's
fault.
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilo! Es culpa de
la rueda negra.

dialog.english:
I feel refreshed now, thanks to
you.
dialog.translation:
Ya me siento mejor,
gracias a vosotros.

dialog.english:
Hey, Whamon, how far is it to
Server Continent from here?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Whamon, ¿a cuánto está
el Continente Server desde
aquí?

dialog.english:
It would take me five days to get
there.
That's pretty far...

So then, do you know anything
about those Tags that Devimon hid?
Or the Crests for that matter?
dialog.translation:
Entonces, ¿sabes algo de
esos Circuitos que escondió
Devimon? ¿O de los Emblemas?

dialog.english:
Tags and Crests...I don't know
anything.
Oh...

But I do know that Devimon went
under the sea once and put
something there...
dialog.translation:
Pero sí sé que Devimon
fue una vez bajo el mar
y dejó algo allí...

dialog.english: Where?

On the way to Server Continent.
Allow me to escort you.
dialog.translation:
De camino al Continente
Server. Dejad que os escolte.

dialog.english: Thanks so much!

Yeah! We're counting on you,
Whamon!

It's a bit chilly. So the Tags and
Crests are around here...
dialog.translation:
Hace frío. Los Circuitos
y Emblemas deben estar
por aquí...

dialog.english: Yeah, let's go look for them!
It's...
...a convenience store!
Aaaaaaaaah!
It's Drimogemon!
Tai, we'll take care of this!
Tai, we'll take care of this!

We found the Tags in the
convenience store!

So if we combine the Tags and the
Crests...

...we'll be able to evolve even
further, right?

Yeah, so we'll make sure to find
those Crests!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, así que buscaremos
esos Emblemas seguro!

dialog.english: Sorry to keep you waiting, Whamon!

It's no problem at all. I'll take
you to Server Continent.
dialog.translation:
No pasa nada. Os llevo
al Continente Server.

dialog.english:
All right, thanks, Whamon! I
wonder what Server Continent is
like?
dialog.translation:
¡Vale, gracias, Whamon!
¿Cómo será el Continente
Server?

dialog.english: It's gonna be fun, Tai!

I'm sure there are other Digimon
who want to help you.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que hay otros Digimon
que querrán ayudaros.

dialog.english: All right, thanks!

I'm sorry for causing you trouble
when I was being controlled by
Devimon...
dialog.translation:
Siento haberos causado
problemas cuando Devimon
me controlaba...

dialog.english:
Don't worry about it! It's all in
the past.
dialog.translation:
¡No te preocupes! Ya es
cosa del pasado.

dialog.english:
DigiCarp is delicious! Doesn't
matter if you boil it or bake it!
dialog.translation:
¡La DigiCarpa está buena!
¡Da igual si la hierves o
la horneas!

dialog.english:
Huh! I'll have to ask Matt to
teach me how to cook it sometime.
dialog.translation:
¡Vaya! Tendré que pedir
a Matt que me enseñe a
cocinarla algún día.

dialog.english: Ugh...It's way too hot today...

Huh, really? I feel like it's a
bit colder than usual.
dialog.translation:
A mí me parece que hace
más frío de lo normal.

dialog.english:
Being differently-typed Digimon
must be hard.
dialog.translation:
Ser Digimon de otro tipo
debe ser difícil.

dialog.english:
DigiEarthworms are delicious, you
know. Are you sure you don't want
to try some?
dialog.translation:
Las DigiLombrices están
buenas, ¿sabes? ¿Seguro que
no quieres probar un poco?

dialog.english: Ugh, no!

It's probably a bad thing for me
to keep avoiding fish.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que está mal que
siga evitando el pescado.

dialog.english:
After Tai and his friends
defeated Drimogemon...
dialog.translation:
Cuando Tai y sus amigos
vencieron a Drimogemon...

dialog.english:
they found the Tags inside the
convenience store.
dialog.translation:
encontraron los Circuitos
dentro de la tienda.

dialog.english: Obtained Logs!
Obtained DigiEarthworms!
Obtained DigiCarp!
